reason: The new GET `unsubscribe` action does mutate state (app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:98-116, config/routes.rb `get "t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe"`), but it is behind `ensure_logged_in` (topics_controller.rb:8-28; application_controller.rb:408-410, 97-103) and the emailed URL carries no token (app/models/topic.rb:719), so a mail client or scanner prefetching without the user's session cookie is redirected to "/" and changes nothing. The state-changing GET is still triggerable by any request carrying the session cookie (e.g. a cross-site embed), but that is not the prefetcher scenario claimed.
